use_cases: Tab navigation with smoothly animated sliding background indicator between tab items
Interactive card grids or lists where background highlight follows user selection
Select or dropdown menus with animated background transitions between options
Navigation menus with hover or click-activated background effects
Interactive form elements requiring visual feedback on selection changes
ai_summary: A reusable animated background wrapper component from motion-primitives that creates smooth shared-layout transitions between child elements using motion/react's layoutId. Supports both click-based and hover-based interactions via the enableHover prop, with configurable transitions. Acts as a primitive for building tab bars, selection menus, and interactive navigation with professional-grade animations.
